description: Temporary endpoint containment. Blocks multipart JCE extension operations, including the documented profile import path.
affected_versions: joomlacontenteditor.net Joomla Content Editor (JCE) extension for Joomla: 1.0.0-2.9.99.4; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Blocks multipart JCE extension operations, including the documented profile import path.
limitations: Multipart body fields are not parsed; this intentionally contains all multipart operations on this extension. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate JCE profile imports and multipart uploads are denied.
